title: SIDESTORY: LINGERING ECHOES RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: LINGERING ECHOES RERUN
DURATION: January 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Lingering Echoes event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Afterglow Hall]
Duration : January 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 15, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Back Alleys]
Duration : January 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 15, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Spy Base]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Spy Base] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARD: [★★★★★: Czerny], Afterglow-Styled Music Room Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, [Sheet Music], etc.
[Composer's Mailbox]
DURATION: January 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Sheet Music] by clearing event stages and completing [Spy Base] missions. [Sheet Music] can be used to redeem items from [Composer's Mailbox].
REWARD: Czerny's token, Afterglow-Styled Music Room Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
- Items in the Intelligence Certification Area will have the available purchase amount increased on top of the existing amount and have new items added when event reruns begin.
- Operators Ebenholz, Czerny, and Hibiscus the Purifier will gain more trust during the event rerun.
- After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Side Story] permanently from January 19, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – DISSONANZEN
DURATION: January 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Dissonanzen], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting
★★★★★★: Ebenholz
★★★★★: Hibiscus the Purifier / Lunacub

NOTE: This is a [Standard Headhunting], and the operators available will be consistent with the latest permanent [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 VITAFIELD [REWILDER] SERIES CLASSICS NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: January 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics - Freeland Tuneseeker for Czerny
04 ACHIEVEMENT STAR COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: January 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Achievement Star Collection - Sport For All - Flametail
- Achievement Star Collection - Light Gun Adjuster - Aosta
- Achievement Star Collection - Trendsetting Player - Kirara
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET AFTERGLOW-STYLED MUSIC ROOM
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Lingering Echoes event rewards and redeem in Composer's Mailbox (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
- Duration: January 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
06 MAY THE SUNSHINE STILL SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: January 5, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7) - January 15, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to receive generous rewards, including: Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Orundum, Elite Materials, and more. Participating in the first 5 days of the event can also be rewarded with furniture corresponding to the flavor of choice.

The first five days of the event (not the first five days of signing in) will open a limited time Global Support event. Players will be asked to choose from the "Saccharine Red Bean Meets Jujubes" and "Saliferous Egg Yolk With Fresh Meat" to support.
After completing the selection, the player will receive sign-in rewards. Flavor preferences will be calculated based on the records, and player will receive the corresponding title.

After the competition, participants obtain Dragon Boat Festival Chair furniture the next time they sign in. Which furniture they get depends on the preference that they chose (players who are Sweetsalt Liberal will get the reward of the winning side)
※If the player did not participate in the support event, they will not be able to get the furniture.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 3: Chip Catalyst * 1, Skill Summary - 1 * 30
Day 4: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 5: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 6: Furniture Part * 300, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
NOTE:
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.

- In this event, the furniture that players can obtain will be determined by their preference (players who are Sweetsalt Liberal will receive furniture rewards the winning side). Players can only obtain one furniture from this event.
